label: D-1ff9e9

defects.summary: CodexRuntime.QuotaKeyOf answers "codex" as a virtual member and only CustomCodexRuntime overrides it, so DeepseekRuntime (also a CodexRuntime subclass, a separate API-key account) inherits the codex key: a DeepSeek refusal parks every codex row, and a DeepSeek answer lifts a real codex cooldown, which breaks D3's rule that a key belongs to one sign-in.

The test changes the zone by setting the TZ environment variable and asserts TimeZoneInfo.Local.BaseUtcOffset == +9 h, but .NET on Windows ignores TZ, so this test fails in ci.yml's windows-latest job, which runs the whole MCP suite (the objective run was Linux only).

The locked write runs as Task.Run(() => Apply(changes), ct) with the round's token, so a round that ends on its deadline or is cancelled also drops the codex, Claude and Kimi parks that needed no probe, where D5 makes only a cancelled probe park nothing.

For an agy model the table does not know, an undecided RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (Spent == null) goes to QuotaReset.FromText, whose word scan calls it hopeless and parks it on a guess, although D5/D10 say an undetermined agy refusal is never a parked row.

The guess-doubling count is worked out twice, once before the lock in ParkAsync and again under the lock in Change.Park.Applied, and CooldownWords.Iso repeats ServerNotice.Iso with a different precision.
S40's theory checks verdicts by ToString().StartWith rather than by value, and S33 checks the cooldown line with a regex instead of the exact S31 line.

summary: All four stories are delivered: the structured verdict, the AGY_ERROR and /quota readers with every edge case, the locked fail-open cooldown file, the per-key aggregation after the round, the roster exclusion, the wire member and the card; all 43 scenarios are present (S14 renamed) and pass, and the deviations are recorded carefully and match the code. Two major defects hold the score down: DeepseekRuntime inherits the codex quota key, so one account's refusal parks the other's rows, and a new TZ-based test will fail on the Windows CI job; the other findings are minor.
